title: Target Brings the World of ACOTAR to Fans with Exclusive Merch and Midnight Book Release Celebrations
summary: Explore Target’s ACOTAR collection, nearly 85% exclusive to Target, with most items under $20 and an Oct. 26 midnight release for the new book.
body_markdown:
Ready to return to Prythian?


With the sixth “A Court of Thorns and Roses” (ACOTAR) book, “A Court of Splintered Harmony,” arriving Oct. 27, Target is giving fans can’t-miss ways to step back into the world of ACOTAR. Starting Oct. 11, guests can shop exclusive merchandise inspired by the courts and characters, and on Oct. 26, guests can attend midnight book release events at select stores. Target is showing up for the fandom and creating an easy, one-stop destination to shop, celebrate and connect around the highly anticipated release of book six.


The wide-ranging assortment showcases Target’s merchandise authority, bringing together brands guests love, exclusive finds and plenty of “if you know, you know” details across the collection, with most items priced under $20.


### Only at Target: Exclusive ACOTAR finds


Nearly 85% of the assortment is available only at Target, including:


- **“A Court of Splintered Harmony” gift with purchase:** Guests who purchase book six at Target will receive an exclusive gift, designed in partnership with author Sarah J. Maas herself (while supplies last).
- **BrüMate Starfall and Cursebreaker drinkware:** Choose the Starfall or Cursebreaker design across the Era Flip 40oz tumbler and Müv 15 travel mug.
- **ACOTAR-inspired teas:** Brew Suriel Earl Greyer Lavender Black Tea, Night Court Velaris Jasmine Green Tea, Spring Court Raspberry Rose Hibiscus Tea and more. Tea with the Suriel, anyone?
- **Alex and Ani jewelry:** Bracelets and earrings from the Stars and Dreams and Amarantha’s Riddle collections bring fan-favorite references into accessories.
- **Series-inspired apparel:** Cozy up in fleece sweatshirts or tees inspired by the Bone Carver and Starfall.
- **fine’ry. x ACOTAR fragrances:** A four-scent lineup brings familiar parts of the ACOTAR world into fragrance, giving fans a new way to connect with the series.
- **ACOTAR tabletop game:** Enjoy a game night and see which member of your inner circle comes out on top.
- **BOOMCHICKAPOP Sweet & Salty Kettle Corn:** A fun snack for reading, release night and a fandom that knows its characters can be equal parts sweet and salty.


Additionally, fans will find even more[ACOTAR merch at Target](https://www.target.com/c/sarah-j-maas/-/N-cb935) , including totes and bag charms, journals and coloring activities, keepsake puzzles, mugs and pouches, Kindle cases, book nooks, figurines and other collectibles.


### Celebrate the next chapter at midnight


On Oct. 26, the celebration moves from the pages to Target stores.


At approximately 250 Target stores, guests are invited to a special “A Court of Splintered Harmony” midnight release experience, with the opportunity to purchase the new book at midnight, test their ACOTAR knowledge with themed trivia, shop the collection, take photos and celebrate alongside fellow book lovers.


The first 100 guests will receive a complimentary Bryaxis keychain and commemorative entry ticket, granting them the opportunity to purchase the new book at midnight. Guests who purchase an ACOTAR Hasbro game will receive a special gift with purchase, while supplies last. Events will run from Oct. 26 at 9pm through Oct. 27 at 12am, local time. "A Court of Splintered Harmony” pre-order pick-up will not be available at midnight. Guests who pre-ordered the new book can visit stores when they open on Oct. 27 to receive their copy.


[Find a participating store and event details on Target.com](https://www.target.com/c/midnight-release-event/-/N-2jgu5)


From discovering a new piece for the collection to gathering with other fans, Target is bringing the world of ACOTAR to life and giving the fandom a new way to experience it together.


Here’s to the stars who listen, and the readers already planning their Target run.
